name: Carrion Defense Works Hemorrhage Rifle HR-6 'Bloodletter'
description: A precision rifle firing rounds containing a micro-encapsulated anticoagulant payload that releases into the wound channel upon penetration. The compound — Carrion's proprietary HemoDisrupt formula — prevents blood clotting at the wound site and in the surrounding vasculature for approximately 45 minutes, turning what would be a survivable gunshot wound into a potentially fatal hemorrhagic event. The round itself is a standard 7.62mm profile that performs normally in flight, with the anticoagulant capsule contained in a hollow cavity behind the penetrator tip. Carrion describes it as 'extended incapacitation ammunition' in internal documents.
specifications:
caliber: 7.62mm with anticoagulant payload
magazine: 10 rounds
effective range: 100-600 meters
anticoagulant duration: 45 minutes at wound site
payload: 0.3ml HemoDisrupt micro-encapsulated
weight: 4.2 kg with optic
optics: Variable 3-12x with environmental compensation
barrel: Free-floating match grade, 550mm
story_hooks: A seemingly minor shooting wound killed a Tier 3 businessperson eighteen minutes after the injury — toxicology reveals HemoDisrupt in the wound channel, turning a misdemeanor assault into a chemical weapons case.
Carrion's HemoDisrupt formula has been reverse-engineered and someone is loading it into standard ammunition — any gun could now fire hemorrhage rounds.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, purpose-built precision rifle with an almost surgical aesthetic. The Bloodletter presents as a modern marksman's platform — long, tapered barrel beneath a floating action, with minimal ornamentation. The silhouette reads as predatory and cold, engineered for distance work rather than rapid engagement.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length: 112 cm | Barrel length: 55 cm | Width at receiver: 7 cm | Height with optic: 18 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Hefty but well-balanced — 4.2 kg settles into the shoulder with authority. The free-floating barrel creates a sense of precision weight rather than bulk; it feels like an instrument calibrated for lethality.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade aluminum receiver with steel barrel. Polymer furniture in reinforced thermoplastic composite. Magazine feed system in hardened steel.
physical_description.finish: Matte charcoal anodize on aluminum surfaces with brushed stainless steel accents around the breech. Barrel features a dull gunmetal finish — intentionally non-reflective. Polymer furniture is textured matte black with subtle ribbing.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: gunmetal gray and matte black | Accents: brushed steel around action, subtle red safety indicator dot
physical_description.grip_texture: Aggressive checkered polymer grip with rubberized palm swell. The foregrip features deep finger grooves. All contact surfaces are non-slip, designed for gloved operation in wet conditions.
distinctive_features: Transparent ammunition magazine with visible round stack — brass casings visible against translucent polymer
Micro-etched ballistic scale on the receiver for range compensation
Large bolt handle with integrated charging lug for gloved manipulation
Integrated cable management routing along the underside of the handguard
Slight concave depression at the muzzle break designed for specialized round loading
Faint hazmat-adjacent warning symbology laser-etched below the magazine well (Φ symbol with X overlay)
Environmental compensation turret on optic base with temperature/altitude dial markings
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: CARRION DEFENSE WORKS in small block lettering on the left side of the receiver, just forward of the trigger guard. Serial number stamped on the barrel extension. Model designation 'HR-6' etched discreetly on the magazine housing. Internal markings visible when action is cycled.
physical_description.condition_typical: These weapons are meticulously maintained by their operators — field condition shows tight tolerances, minimal fouling, obsessive barrel care. When used, they show evidence of professional maintenance: cleaned actions, protected optics, stock components replaced rather than repaired. Scarring rare; when present, it's precise rather than chaotic.
